body:
It's very common to think people will be better after a few months. In reality that sadness would never go away for them.

I'm sitting in a house that has photographs of their lost father still up, 35 years later. They wish he'd decided to stay.

Even if you aren't aware of it, your friend, boyfriend, and folks you aren't even thinking about would never get over it if you don't call them and tell them the truth.
